hypotheses.hypothesis: connector() could be invoked without the person's access token while still reaching sync/agent routes.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Federation return navigation accepts an off-origin returnTo because completeSignIn never calls assertSafeReturnTo.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Pending storage could steer the token POST or JWKS fetch to an attacker-controlled host.
hypotheses.evidence: packages/app-core/src/lib/federation.ts:586-590 resolvePinnedEndpoints over TRUSTED_UPSTREAMS; token fetch at 593 uses pinned.tokenEndpoint; readIdentity at 625 uses pinned.jwksUri.

hypotheses.hypothesis: readIdentity accepts tokens from issuers outside the compiled and operator allowlists.
hypotheses.evidence: packages/app-core/src/lib/federation.ts:744-754 refuses when issuer is not in upstreamByIssuer, isBrokeredIssuer, or isOperatorIdpIssuer (unless orgSlug leg); audience and exp checked at 756-770.

local_check: Source review of completeSignInDefault and readIdentity on worktree tip; federation-endpoint-pin module read for pin semantics.
result_one_line: Token exchange uses resolvePinnedEndpoints; readIdentity enforces issuer, audience, expiry, and trusted-issuer allowlist before saveSession.

hypotheses.hypothesis: A caller could open a guest vault while guestsAllowed is false by bypassing UI.
